_why: Edits the showrunner's drafts to the canon, one call per chapter, side by side (app/draftedit.py). Cold: this is checking and minimal change, not invention. Reads the whole canon every call, so a big context and room for a whole chapter back.
_help: Committed. Provider and model are usually set in the UI (⚙ Model). null = the .env default. API keys never go here: they're saved per provider in secrets/keys.json.
